summary: Through road beside golf course with no parked cars and only a narrow tree-lined edge.
reasons: Through road, no cars parked along kerb
Ground beside lane is tree and fence
Golf course behind, houses across road

drivers.seclusion: Golf course and trees on the east side; homes 15-25 m across the road, which would otherwise be good.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow edge between lane and dense trees and fence; no clear pull-off wide enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Moving cars on a through route linking suburbs; no parked vehicles seen in either image.
drivers.convention: No sign of kerbside parking or marked lane on this side.

flags: Low-lying: about 7 m elevation, waterway 53 m away
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy on the east side shades the kerb from the morning sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the edge is firm enough to park on

best_section.where: east kerb of Indooroopilly Road, beside the golf course trees
